title: Scenic Sailing Experience in Vancouver with Local Captain
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join us for a public sailing tour and experience Vancouver’s coastline aboard a beautifully maintained sailing yacht. Choose between Harbour & Wildlife Sail on Saturdays or Sunset Sail on Thursdays, each offering a relaxed cruise through scenic coastal waters with city skyline views, surrounding mountains, and possible wildlife sightings such as seals and seabirds.

Led by an experienced local skipper, public group sailing tours offer a comfortable and memorable way to explore Vancouver from the water. Relax on deck, enjoy the scenery, and discover a different side of the city.
